title: Powered heterogeneity through the COMPARATIVE ENGINE pass (#342)
question: Does the production comparative pass (compose_comparative_metric_prompt + elicit_visit_delta) recover the certified who-responds-more heterogeneity when given segment-rich personas? The e2e proved DIRECTION but GMM personas gave clustered deltas (no heterogeneity).
design: gender x recency x channel x email strata (the certified 38-cell set), each a descriptive Persona; real per-cell visit uplift from the RCT; k=4 comparative-delta elicitations/cell, averaged. Spearman(predicted delta, real uplift) + permutation p (PRIMARY).

predicted.spearman_rho: ~0.30 (uncertain: rich personas may recover what GMM personas could not; could also stay clustered)

PASS_FAIL_BAR: CERTIFIED iff Spearman rho > 0.30 AND permutation p < 0.05
decision_rule: CERTIFIED -> the comparative engine pass recovers heterogeneity given segment-rich audiences; strong case to enrich the production persona pack + flip the flag after a deliberate decision. NOT certified -> direction is the engine's reach today; heterogeneity needs richer audience modeling (a larger lever). Honest either way.
